newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Miner eyes nickel near Centaur find.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Miner eyes nickel near Centaur find.

text.p: Mine exploration company Tulloch Resources NL, said on Friday it has acquired a further 10 tenements adjacent to its Vettersburg nickel and gold project in Western Australia.
The acquisition increases Tulloch's land holdings in the Mount Pleasant district of the state to over 4,200 hectares, the company said.

Tulloch said Vettersburg is a key holding for the company because it shares a common boundary with the Cawse nickel project, owned by Centaur Mining and Exploration Ltd, which has recorded 193 million tonnes of ore 0.7 percent nickel and 0.04 percent cobalt.
Drilling of nickel anomalies at Vettersburg are scheduled to start following a listing on the Australian Stock Exchange, planned for later this year, the company said.
